newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spanish police seize tonne of hashish in Mellilla.
newsitem.headline: Spanish police seize tonne of hashish in Mellilla.

text.p: Spanish police have seized a tonne of hashish and arrested six people in a raid on a scrapyard in the north African Spanish enclave of Melilla, officials said in a statement on Wednesday.

Narcotics officers began investigating the premises after noticing irregularities in the sale of vehicles at the yard. Automobiles were frequently taken apart and were thought to be used to hide drugs.
Police arrested three Moroccan men as they were unloading packets from a van with darkened windows on September 27.
The parcels contained 27 kg (60 pounds) of hashish and another 947 kg (2,088 pounds) was found in the van. Three other men were subsequently detained.
